download_rcdm_dino_trunk: download the RCDM DINO trunk model checkpoint from the FAIR public files server
download_rcdm_dino_head: download the RCDM DINO head model checkpoint including the projection head weights
download_rcdm_simclr_trunk: download the RCDM SimCLR trunk model checkpoint from the FAIR public files server
download_rcdm_supervised: download the RCDM supervised model checkpoint trained with labeled data from FAIR
download_rcdm_barlow_head: download the RCDM Barlow Twins head model checkpoint including projection head weights
